items.summary_en: A female lab worker died of a "pneumonia" of unknown origin, sparking fears she may have been exposed to pneumonic plague A psychic known as the "Prophet of Doom" eerily forecast a "biological type of illness" just days before a plague researcher passed away in Russia. Last week, a female laboratory worker from the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East succumbed to "pneumonia" from an unidentified source, raising concerns she may have contracted pneumonic plague. items.summary_zh: 一名女实验室工作人员死于不明原因的“肺炎”，引发人们担心她可能感染了肺鼠疫。就在俄罗斯一名鼠疫研究员去世前几天，一位被称为“末日先知”的通灵者诡异地预言了一种“生物型疾病”。上周，西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所的一名女实验室工作人员死于不明来源的“肺炎”，引发人们担心她可能感染了病毒。

The eerie image shows a nebula that seems to resemble a witch’s head in profile — and has been given the fitting name ‘Witch Head Nebula’. items.title_en: Archaeologists Exploring The Mountain Forests Of Central Germany Just Discovered An Ancient Roman Temple Dedicated To The God Of War
items.title_zh: 考古学家探索德国中部的山林刚刚发现了一座供奉战神的古罗马神庙
items.summary_en: Thomas Kurella/hr Archaeologists uncovered a Roman temple dedicated to Mars, the god of war, in a German forest. In the forests of Germany’s Taunus Mountains, near the modern-day town of Rosbach vor der Höhe, archaeologists recently found the remnants of a Roman temple dedicated to Mars, god of war . Within, they recovered a number of astonishing artifacts, including a small bronze statuette of the goddess Victoria as well as two votive stones. Although archaeologists had long been excavating the nearby Roman fort…
items.summary_zh: 考古学家在德国森林中发现了一座供奉战神马尔斯的罗马神庙。在德国陶努斯山脉的森林中，靠近现代城镇罗斯巴赫的地方，考古学家最近发现了一座供奉战神马尔斯的罗马神庙的遗迹。他们在里面发现了许多令人惊叹的文物，包括一尊维多利亚女神的小青铜雕像以及两块还愿石。尽管考古学家早已
